asset.title: Luxury berry juice testimonial ad

creativeDirectionOptions.prompt:
Create a premium product testimonial ad based on the uploaded product image.

Use the reference image as the source of truth for the product’s appearance. Preserve the exact bottle shape, tall cylindrical gift tube packaging, dark burgundy-and-cream color palette, gold accents, label proportions, and all distinctive branding details visible on the packaging. Keep the product large, realistic, and visually dominant.

Place the bottle and gift tube prominently in the lower half of the composition on a minimal studio surface, with elegant realistic shadows, luxury studio lighting, cinematic reflections, and subtle highlights. Keep the product tactile, premium, and expensive.

Generate a short testimonial-style section that feels believable and high-end. Since no real customer quote or rating is provided, use a short benefit-led trust line instead of a fake testimonial. Keep it concise and polished, such as: “Rich berry taste, beautifully presented.” Do not add a fake customer name or star rating.

The testimonial should appear inside a premium transparent glass-style text box with soft transparency, subtle frosted blur, rounded corners, elegant soft shadows, and a modern luxury UI feel.

Use a minimal premium background with smooth luxury gradients inspired by the packaging: deep berry, burgundy, cream, champagne, and warm beige tones. No cluttered environment, no busy props, no real-life scene. Optionally include a few subtle black raspberry berries as elegant product-adjacent elements, kept minimal and refined.

Typography should feel premium, minimal, elegant, modern, and highly readable, using refined sans-serif styling. Keep the text layout clean and balanced, like a modern luxury Instagram or Pinterest product advertisement.

**Exact on-image text:**
- **Rich berry taste, beautifully presented.**

The final ad should feel like a premium beauty or wellness Instagram ad, a polished startup product launch visual, and a high-end commercial product testimonial. Everything should feel cohesive, modern, expensive, art-directed, and visually balanced.

Negative prompt: cheap ecommerce ad, cluttered layout, flat lighting, ugly gradients, busy background, fake reflections, distorted packaging, low-quality rendering, Canva-style design, loud typography, meme aesthetic, harsh shadows, stock-photo look, messy composition, childish colors, fake AI product render, low-detail text box, plastic CGI look.

asset.mainAssetCreativeDirectionPrompt:
Create an ultra-realistic, fast-paced UGC creator POV-style 15-second product video for **BERRYWELL Black raspberry Juice (700ml)**, using the attached reference image as the source of truth for the product’s appearance. Preserve the bottle shape, dark berry liquid, label placement, cap, and any visible packaging details exactly, but do not copy the reference image’s white background, studio composition, or camera angle. Make it feel like a real person filming on their phone at home in Singapore.

Goal: sell the juice as a simple daily wellness drink with a rich berry taste and an easy routine.

Structure the video like real UGC:

1) Hook / Problem
Open with the creator looking into the phone in a kitchen or home dining area, slightly tired and relatable: they’re bored of plain drinks and want something that feels refreshing but still part of a daily routine.
- Camera: arm-length selfie framing, slight hand shake, natural indoor light.
- Spoken line: **“Okay, I was so over plain drinks every day…”**

2) Product Solution
Quick punch-in reveal of the BERRYWELL bottle on a counter, then back to the creator holding it casually.
- Show the label clearly for a second, but keep it natural and handheld.
- Spoken line: **“Then I tried this black raspberry juice from Berrywell.”**

3) Real Demo
Show a believable real-life pour: open the bottle, pour a small amount into a glass, then dilute with cold water or serve chilled over ice. Show the deep dark berry color swirling in the glass.
- Camera: handheld close-up insert, slight reframing, quick cut back to face reaction.
- Add natural ambient sounds: bottle cap twist, liquid pour, glass clink.
- Spoken line: **“You only need a little bit, and it tastes so rich.”**

4) Satisfying Result
Show the finished drink with ice on the table, creator taking a sip, then a relieved smile and small surprised reaction.
- Emphasize the refreshed mood and easy daily-use vibe, not medical claims.
- Spoken line: **“It’s actually really nice chilled — like, super easy to keep in my routine.”**

5) Reaction
Creator gives a quick honest laugh or nod, holding the glass in frame.
- Spoken line: **“Okay wait… this is kind of my new go-to.”**

6) CTA
End with creator pointing gently toward the bottle on the table, still in casual selfie POV.
- Spoken line: **“If you want a simple berry drink, go check out Berrywell.”**

Visual direction:
- self-shot creator POV, casual home environment, phone-shot realism
- slight shake, imperfect framing, quick punch-ins, fast but clear pacing
- product shown in hand, on counter, and in poured glass
- keep product accurate to the reference image across all shots
- use natural colors: deep berry reds, dark plum tones, soft kitchen neutrals
- no polished ad look, no cinematic lighting, no tripod feel

Editing and pacing:
- quick jump cuts every 1–3 seconds
- one or two punch-in zooms on the bottle and poured drink
- minimal transitions, creator-style cut rhythm
- maintain a believable real-life UGC pace

Audio:
- natural female or male creator voice, casual and unpolished
- light ambient room tone, soft TikTok-style background music low in the mix
- bottle cap twist, pour sound, ice clink, light sip sound
- voice should stay clearly audible and conversational
- end cleanly without a final sound hit

Important product details to naturally imply visually, without reading them aloud:
- 700ml bottle
- black raspberry / bokbunja juice
- premium Korean product
- daily drinking vibe
- serve chilled or diluted
- rich berry color and taste

Negative prompt:
No subtitles, captions, readable text overlays, end cards, fake social media UI, polished commercial look, cinematic shots, tripod shots, CGI, fake textures, staged acting, overproduced lighting, exaggerated enthusiasm, unsupported health or medical claims, invented certifications, invented awards, distorted bottle shape, wrong label, wrong cap, incorrect packaging, product inconsistency between shots, copied white studio background from the reference image, copied composition from the reference image, additional brand logos, third-party brand marks, warped hands, broken lip-sync, unreadable text, morphing objects, final-second boom or stinger.

styleAsset.title: Testimonial
styleAsset.goal: For premium ads led by trust, reviews, or social proof.
styleAsset.selectedCreativeDirectionPrompt:
## Style Prompt

Create a premium digital product testimonial ad based on uploaded product references, screenshots, branding assets, event graphics, landing pages, UI previews, mockups, thumbnails, dashboards, or digital-product visuals.

First, deeply analyze the digital product from its smallest visual and branding details, including:
- product category
- event, course, or session type
- branding style
- typography system
- UI design language
- color palette
- visual hierarchy
- creator or business aesthetic
- target audience
- emotional appeal
- startup positioning
- luxury, creator, wellness, or business vibe
- overall digital-brand identity

Intelligently determine whether the promoted item is:
- event
- challenge
- digital file or course
- session
- business page
- creator product
- webinar
- online community
- coaching program
- SaaS tool
- creative service
- educational product

Then automatically generate a high-end testimonial ad in the same style as a modern luxury Instagram/Pinterest digital-product campaign.

The final result should feel like:
- a premium startup campaign
- a luxury creator-brand advertisement
- a polished social-media digital-product launch
- a cinematic online-business commercial
- a premium SaaS, wellness, or creator-economy visual

⸻

### Smart Product Environment Analysis

Intelligently analyze:
- what type of digital product it is
- what environment naturally fits the product
- what visual storytelling supports the niche
- what premium cinematic background best communicates the product emotionally

Important:
- The digital product does not always need to appear inside a laptop.
- Creatively decide how to visually represent the product.
- The environment/background should feel naturally connected to the product category.

Examples:
- editing course: cinematic editing studio with timelines and media screens
- finance session: premium investing office with elegant charts and wealth visuals
- design event: creative workspace with typography grids and design-system visuals
- yoga session: calm luxury wellness environment with warm natural lighting
- business coaching: startup boardroom or premium entrepreneurial workspace
- AI tool: futuristic soft-tech interface environment
- webinar: luxury online-stage or cinematic presentation setup
- creator challenge: energetic creator workspace with visual storytelling props
- productivity system: elegant desk setup with organized workflow visuals
- guidebook or PDF: premium reading environment, books, printed layouts, vintage desk styling
- creative event: immersive branded event atmosphere with premium signage
- sound pack or productivity assets: cinematic creator desk with audio-reactive visuals

Automatically determine:
- what belongs in the background
- what props support the story
- what environment feels premium and believable
- how to visually communicate the product without clutter

Important:
- Background elements should support the composition.
- They should not overpower the layout.
- They should not become chaotic.
- The product environment should feel intentional and art-directed.

The final image should feel immersive, premium, cinematic, product-specific, modern, and expensive.

⸻

### Digital Product Composition

The digital product should:
- remain visually dominant
- appear professionally art-directed
- preserve the exact branding and identity
- look realistic, premium, and expensive

Choose the best visual representation for the product. This may include:
- dashboards
- event visuals
- course materials
- creator setups
- premium spaces
- branded environments
- presentation stages
- digital interfaces
- books or PDF layouts
- immersive workshop spaces
- editing setups
- holographic UI
- luxury workspace compositions

Important:
- Avoid forcing every product into a laptop mockup.
- The visual representation should feel natural for the niche.

The composition should feel cinematic, modern, balanced, luxurious, and professionally art-directed.

⸻

### Testimonial Section

The testimonial text box should be the main visual focus of the composition.

Important:
- The testimonial box should visually dominate more than the background.
- The viewer's eyes should immediately go to the testimonial first.
- The environment should support the testimonial, not compete with it.

Generate one short believable customer testimonial based on the digital product type.

If a real testimonial, customer quote, rating, or customer name is provided in the context, use it accurately.

If no real testimonial is provided, create a short conservative testimonial-style quote and first name that feel natural, premium, and editable. Bold any assumed testimonial, rating, or name in the final prompt so the user can quickly notice and edit it. Do not imply specific measurable results, income, rankings, medical outcomes, guaranteed transformation, or verified proof unless supported by the provided context.

The testimonial should:
- feel emotionally positive but natural
- be short and impactful
- match the product category tone
- avoid cheesy marketing copy
- avoid long paragraphs

Examples of tone:
- "This completely changed my workflow."
- "Honestly the best session I've joined."
- "Made everything finally make sense."
- "Wish I found this earlier."

The testimonial should appear inside a large ultra-transparent premium text box.

The text box should have:
- very subtle transparency
- extremely soft frosted blur
- barely-there glass effect
- clean soft edges
- elegant rounded corners
- subtle layered depth
- minimal reflections
- cinematic softness
- premium airy transparency

Important:
- The text box should feel more transparent than opaque.
- The background should softly show through the text box.
- The transparency should feel elegant and atmospheric, not heavy.
- Avoid thick glassmorphism or strong frosted effects.
- Avoid solid white boxes.
- Avoid hard edges or strong UI styling.

The text box should feel soft, airy, subtle, cinematic, luxurious, modern, and visually lightweight.

The testimonial layout should include:
- subtle star rating above when appropriate
- short testimonial quote
- customer first name below in smaller elegant font

The testimonial box should remain the hero element while feeling visually light and transparent.

⸻

### Digital Product Name Placement

Below the testimonial box, place the digital product name in small elegant typography.

Important:
- The product name should feel subtle and understated.
- Not large headline typography.
- Not visually dominant.
- The testimonial box should remain the hero element.

The product name should function like:
- a premium brand label
- a subtle product signature
- an elegant supporting detail

Examples of tone:
- AI Editing Course
- Founders Network Night
- First Million Guidebook
- Designers Unite Event

Use:
- small premium sans-serif typography
- refined clean spacing
- elegant minimalist hierarchy
- subtle startup-brand styling
- understated editorial placement

Optionally below it, add a very small CTA or pricing line.

Examples of tone:
- Join Today
- Starting at $29
- Limited Spots
- Live Session

If price, CTA, or availability is not provided, use a conservative generic CTA or offer line instead. Bold any assumed value or assumed copy in the final prompt so the user can quickly notice and edit it.

Important:
- Keep the CTA and pricing visually tiny and secondary.
- The testimonial box should visually dominate the entire composition.

⸻

### Background Direction

The background should feel:
- minimal
- premium
- cinematic
- atmospheric
- expensive
- digitally art-directed

Use:
- darker luxury gradients for stronger readability
- cinematic environmental depth
- premium textures
- elegant scene composition
- subtle storytelling elements
- soft shadow falloff behind the testimonial box
- moody atmospheric contrast

Preferred palettes:
- deep graphite
- muted charcoal
- dark taupe
- warm black
- espresso brown
- smoky gray
- deep champagne shadows
- premium desaturated dark neutrals

Important:
- The background should be slightly darker overall so the testimonial becomes easier to read.
- The testimonial box should softly glow against the darker environment.
- The contrast should feel cinematic and premium, not harsh.
- Avoid bright airy backgrounds.
- Avoid flat black backgrounds.
- Avoid heavy vignettes.

The background should still feel luxurious, soft, atmospheric, premium, modern, visually rich, and understated.

The darker tones should create:
- stronger focus on the testimonial box
- cleaner typography readability
- more cinematic emotional depth
- a more expensive luxury-ad feel

Important:
- The background should remain secondary to the testimonial box.
- No cluttered scenes.
- No chaotic UI overload.
- No random props.
- No oversaturated colors.

The final composition should feel like a luxury cinematic startup advertisement with elegant moody lighting and premium readability.

⸻

### Lighting & Rendering

Use:
- luxury studio lighting
- soft cinematic glow
- elegant reflections
- premium highlights
- subtle bloom
- soft depth of field
- realistic rendering
- cinematic material lighting
- elegant light falloff

Everything should feel:
- professionally art-directed
- premium commercial quality
- cinematic
- polished
- expensive

⸻

### Typography Style

Typography should feel:
- premium
- minimal
- elegant
- modern
- highly readable
- startup-luxury inspired

Use:
- refined sans-serif fonts
- clean spacing
- subtle hierarchy
- modern luxury-tech styling
- premium startup typography
- cinematic editorial composition

Important:
- Avoid loud typography.
- Avoid Canva-style fonts.
- Avoid ecommerce aesthetics.
- Avoid spammy marketing layouts.

Typography should feel effortless, polished, editorial, and expensive.

⸻

### Final Aesthetic

The final ad should feel like:
- a premium startup campaign
- a luxury creator-brand advertisement
- a polished Instagram digital-product ad
- a cinematic SaaS/business launch visual
- a premium online-product testimonial campaign

Everything should feel:
- cohesive
- minimal
- cinematic
- modern
- expensive
- art-directed
- visually balanced
- professionally designed

The viewer should think: "This looks like a real high-end digital brand."

⸻

🚫 Negative Prompt: cheap ecommerce ads, cluttered layouts, tiny testimonial boxes, ugly transparency effects, flat lighting, ugly gradients, busy backgrounds, fake reflections, distorted UI, low-quality rendering, Canva-style design, loud typography, meme aesthetics, harsh shadows, stock-photo look, messy composition, childish colors, fake AI render look, plastic CGI feel, chaotic startup aesthetics, spammy webinar energy, ugly dashboards, excessive UI clutter.
